in_sanskrit.name: विज्ञान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The knowledge that comes from direct experience and understanding of reality.

in_marathi.name: Vijnana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vijnana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vijnana means 'knowledge', 'understanding', or 'wisdom'. It signifies profound comprehension and insight into various fields.
